    The polynomial mesh relations (Proposition 12.8, F_i(t) = a_i t_i) #

    deformation-refinements.tex: "Give t_i total weight −χ_i […] The choices above, made separately in each weight, make F_j homogeneous of coefficient weight χ_j. […] Lemma 12.7 therefore gives F_j = a_j t_j."

    The lifted arrows at t = 1 (with the normal form r_x = Σ_i λ_i R_i) are twisted to every fibre (twArrow): the twist of a component of relative weight γ is multiplied by t^{coords γ}. The twisted arrows are morphisms of the lifted modules of the fibre t, realize every path by the twist of its realization (toLin_pathR_tw), and satisfy r_x = Σ_i λ_i t_i R_i (tw_relation): the retained coefficients are F_i(t) = λ_i t_i.
